newsitem.title: USA: Oregon becomes 35th state to sue tobacco industry.
newsitem.headline: Oregon becomes 35th state to sue tobacco industry.

text.p: Oregon became the 35th state to sue the tobacco industry Tuesday, accusing eight cigarette companies and other defnedants with violating state racketeering and fraud laws.
Oregon Attorney General Hardy Myers also announced the state would join a settlement reached in March by other attorneys general with the Liggett Group, a unit of Brooke Group Ltd.

According to the state's 70-page complaint, filed in Multnomah County Circuit Court in Portland, the state is seeking repayment of state health care expenditures related to illnesses it says were caused by smoking.
The lawsuit also asks for unspecified civil penalties and attorney fees.
Myers, who announced last month that he planned to sue the tobacco industry, estimated Oregon spends $60 million a year in smoking-related Medicaid costs alone.
A spokeswoman for the attorney general said total damages could run between $800 million and $1 billion.
